analogy.rationale: Contraceptives in this class act on ESR1, so estrogen receptor agonists/antagonists share the same target and downstream estrogen-responsive transcriptional program. Most other classes act through unrelated pathways, and the nine cell lines are largely non-reproductive, so overall response is expected to be weak.
